items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: I went out behind him and I said... I said to him Mr. Davila if you're going to open up a new place would you give me an audition and he said yes sure

ctx.x: and how long did you stay at the paddock

I think it was eight weeks eight weeks and the same day the same day that I was on Papa Stopper's program Mr. Sid Davila was there being interviewed and when he went out I went out behind him and I said he said over the radio that he was just getting ready to open up the Mardi Gras lounge and thus and so you know see so when I went out I said to him Mr. Davila if you're going to open up a new place would you give me an audition and he said yes sure I'll give you an audition I said well here's my telephone but he…
well how did you get on Papa Stopper's program?
